explanation: Pooled p = 880 / 16,000 = 0.055. SE = sqrt(0.055 × 0.945 × (1/8,000 + 1/8,000)) = sqrt(0.0000129938) = 0.0036047. The difference is 0.060 - 0.050 = 0.010, so z = 0.010 / 0.0036047 = 2.774, which rounds to 2.77. The pooled rate belongs to this test because the test assumes no effect, so both groups share one rate.
